items.question: What are the Free plan limits?
items.answer: On permanent Free you can maintain up to three active CRM clients, create up to five invoices per UTC calendar month, publish up to three shop services, and operate with a single workspace seat. Payment gateway links on invoices require Pro, Team, or an active Pro trial.

items.question: Can I collect payments online on the Free plan?

items.question: What happens after the 15-day Pro trial ends?
items.answer: If you do not subscribe, the workspace returns to the Free tier quotas. Data you created remains accessible subject to those limits; upgrade anytime to restore unlimited invoices, higher seats, and gateway collection.

items.question: Who is the Free plan best for?

items.question: Does free ERP mean every advanced module is unlimited?
items.answer: No. Free means you can explore the same modules as paid customers, but capacity-sensitive actions enforce the Free quotas. Heavy automation, payroll at scale, or large teams should move to paid tiers for headroom.

items.question: Is my data private on the Free tier?
